app.title: Time booking
app.tagline: Every hour you buy, in view: book time, check budgets, reorder in time.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your business email address.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Your admin creates it for you.

home.loadFailed: The overview could not be loaded

consultant.intro: Your working time at a glance. Only you see your daily and weekly totals.
consultant.ordersDescription: Orders of your company you can book on – each only within its period.

pm.intro: The budget of your orders and what to check.
pm.attentionDescription: Orders with {{percent}} % or more of the budget used – a follow-up order may be needed soon.
pm.allFine: All orders still have enough budget.
pm.ordersDescription: Tap an order to check the work booked on it.

purchasing.intro: Where a follow-up order will be needed soon.
purchasing.endingSoonDescription: Running orders whose period ends within the next {{days}} days.
purchasing.allDescription: All orders with budget and period, the ones ending first on top.

admin.intro: Accounts and security at a glance. Admins see no business data such as bookings or budgets.
admin.lastDayDescription: From the audit log: sign-ins and what was refused.

profile.passwordTemporary: Set by an admin – will be changed at the next sign-in

users.description: All accounts. Only admins create accounts – there is no self-registration.
users.newDescription: Create an account and hand the initial password to the person yourself.
users.name: Name
users.supplierHint: Consultants always belong to a supplier.
users.passwordHint: 10 to 72 characters. The person chooses their own password at the first sign-in.
users.editDescription: Change name, email, role and company. The password stays as it is.
users.ownRoleHint: You cannot change your own role – ask another admin.
users.roleChangeHint: The role only changes while nothing depends on it: no bookings of a consultant, no orders of a project manager.
users.deactivateDescription: The person is signed out at once and can no longer sign in. Their bookings and audit entries stay. You can reactivate the account later.
users.resetDescription: Type a new password and hand it to the person yourself. They are signed out everywhere at once and choose their own password at the next sign-in.
users.passwordReset: Password of {{name}} reset. The person is signed out.

audit.description: Every action in the API: who, what, on what, with which result and why – newest first. Tap a row for all details.
audit.loadFailed: The audit log could not be loaded

suppliers.description: The companies orders are placed with. Tap a name to change it.
suppliers.newDescription: Add a company you order services from.
suppliers.renameDescription: The new name applies at once to all orders and consultants of this company.
suppliers.name: Name

orders.description: All orders with their budget – sums only, no single bookings. Tap an order to change it.
orders.newDescription: Order services from a supplier, with a budget and a period.
orders.editBooked: {{hours}} are already booked on this order: the budget cannot shrink below that, the supplier is fixed, and the period must include all bookings.
orders.title: Title
orders.supplierLocked: Time has been booked – the supplier can no longer be changed.

myOrders.description: The orders you are responsible for. Tap an order to check the work booked on it.
myOrders.empty: You are not responsible for any order.
myOrders.privacyNote: Each booking on its own, to check the work. On purpose without daily or weekly totals per person: you check the work, not the consultants' working hours.
myOrders.noBookings: No time has been booked on this order yet.
myOrders.loadFailed: The order could not be loaded

password.title: Change password
password.description: You will be signed out in all other browsers.
password.descriptionForced: Welcome, {{name}}. Your admin set your password. Choose your own before you continue – then only you know it.
password.hint: 10 to 72 characters, different from the current one.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

booking.title: Book time
booking.description: Book your working time on an order of your company.
booking.alreadyBooked: Already booked on this day: {{booked}} of at most {{limit}}.
booking.overLimit: Too much: {{booked}} are already booked on this day, at most 10 hours are allowed.
booking.workPlaceholder: e.g. built and tested the login page
booking.noOrders: There is no order for your company right now.
booking.mineDescription: Newest first, with the total per day.

calendar.future: In the future – time is booked once it has been worked
calendar.sunday: Sunday – no work on Sundays and public holidays (ArbZG §9)
calendar.holiday: Public holiday ({{name}}) – no work on Sundays and public holidays (ArbZG §9)
calendar.conflict: Conflict: {{booked}} already booked, {{total}} with this booking – more than 10 hours
calendar.legendHours: Number under the day = already booked

errors.DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Booking rejected: more than 10 hours of work per day are not allowed (ArbZG §3).
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Booking rejected: the free budget of this order is not enough.
errors.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Booking rejected: this order does not exist.
errors.ORDER_NOT_ASSIGNED: Booking rejected: you can only book on orders of your own company.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: Booking rejected: the date is in the future. Book time once the work is done.
errors.NOT_YOUR_ORDER: Only the project manager of this order can see its budget and bookings.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The request could not be read.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.CONSULTANT_NEEDS_SUPPLIER: A consultant must belong to a supplier. Choose the consultant's company.
errors.SUPPLIER_ONLY_FOR_CONSULTANTS: Only consultants belong to a supplier. Project managers, purchasing and admins work for the client; leave the supplier empty.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.SUNDAY_OR_HOLIDAY: Booking rejected: no work on Sundays and public holidays (German Working Time Act §9).
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please enter a valid email address and a password.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The server cannot be reached. Is the API running?
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.SUPPLIER_NAME_TAKEN: A supplier with this name already exists.
errors.ORDER_CODE_TAKEN: An order with this order number already exists.
errors.ORDER_PERIOD_INVALID: The period cannot end before it starts.
errors.NOT_A_PROJECT_MANAGER: Only a project manager can be responsible for an order.
errors.BUDGET_BELOW_BOOKED: More time is already booked on this order – the budget cannot be smaller.
errors.SUPPLIER_FIXED_AFTER_BOOKINGS: Time has already been booked on this order, so it stays with its supplier. Create a new order instead.
errors.PERIOD_EXCLUDES_BOOKINGS: There are bookings outside this period. The period must include every booked day.
errors.OUTSIDE_ORDER_PERIOD: Booking rejected: the date is outside the period of this order.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: The role cannot change: bookings or orders depend on it. Create a new account instead – or let purchasing reassign the orders first.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE: You cannot change your own role. Ask another admin.
errors.CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_YOURSELF: You cannot deactivate your own account. Ask another admin.
errors.MANAGES_ORDERS: This project manager is still responsible for orders. Purchasing must assign them to someone else first.
errors.ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED: This account has been deactivated. Contact your admin.
errors.PROJECT_MANAGER_DEACTIVATED: This project manager is deactivated and cannot be responsible for an order.
errors.NEW_PASSWORD_SAME_AS_CURRENT: Choose a new password that differs from the current one.
errors.CANNOT_RESET_OWN_PASSWORD: You do not reset your own password – change it in your profile instead.
errors.INVALID_TIME: Booking rejected: please enter start and end as a time between 00:00 and 23:59.
errors.END_NOT_AFTER_START: Booking rejected: the end must be after the start on the same day.
errors.INVALID_BREAK: Booking rejected: the break must be shorter than the time between start and end.
errors.BOOKING_OVERLAP: Booking rejected: this time overlaps another of your bookings on this day.
